Provident Estate brings you our top 3 Beachfront communities hand selected by our expert real estate consultants. Highlighting distinct features and amenities along with some unique selling points to help you choose which community suits you best.

The Palm Jumeirah

Dubai is a city of wonders with many-a picturesque places to visit and even more to live in! So, if you are wondering which one is the pinnacle of beachfront living, the correct answer is The Palm Jumeirah! It is the largest artificial island in the world, you can even see the beautiful palm tree layout even from space! With a surface area of 5.72 km², the island is host to around 13 different hotels, including the famous Atlantis, The Palm Jumeirah.

There are plenty of cafes, restaurants, boutiques and entertainment venues across the island. Home to Michelin star restaurants; such as Nobu and Torno Subito, Palm Jumeirah is a haven for food lovers with the epitome of luxury taste and experience. Villa owners at the Palm Jumeirah have the ultimate beachfront lifestyle with private beach access. If you are not looking to live in a villa by the sea, you can also choose from posh spacious townhouses as well as luxury apartments. The townhouses offer many options such as 3 bedroom triplex layouts and ones with private balcony pools. This resonates with the up-market luxury living that The Palm community offers its residents. The island also has a monorail that can take you from the mainland all the way to the Atlantis hotel.

The Palm is a much sought-after community for investors and homeowners around the globe. It provides luxury living that is unparalleled to any other community; from luxury homes to world renowned restaurants, The Palm Jumeirah is the idyllic pick for the perfect beachfront lifestyle!

Bluewaters Island

A posh and upscale community with plenty of unique restaurants and entertainment – this is Bluewaters by Meraas. If you are looking for a community that is quiet and refined, yet still close to the hustle and bustle of the city, then look no further than Bluewaters Island!

Home to the world’s largest observation wheel, with hundreds of retail stores to choose from and a newly opened Caesars Palace Hotel, Bluewaters has it all and more! You can enjoy world-class dining experiences and tons of amenities such as The Cove beach, a stunning pool, and a relaxing luxury spa.

The area is surrounded by stunning views of the ocean from all directions. Now picture your family living in a 4 bedroom apartment with a panoramic view of the ocean with sunlight shining into every room in your apartment. With a fully equipped marble-top kitchen and ample space for the whole family to enjoy the large balcony, Bluewaters is the perfect pick for your family. If you are searching for something a little smaller than a 4 bedroom, in that case Bluewaters is ready with 1, 2 and 3 bedroom units for immediate handover. The apartments in Bluewaters are perfect for families and individuals alike and offer an enviable beachfront lifestyle, complete with the best amenities within walking distance!

Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR)

One of the most frequently visited areas in Dubai by tourists and residents alike is Jumeirah Beach Residences, or as it is more popularly called, JBR. Jumeirah Beach Residence has served as a tremendous host for many travelers because of its ideal location, countless entertainment options, hundreds of restaurants and not to mention the beach that has gained a popular reputation.

JBR apartments have a range of different options, from 2 bedroom lofts to 4 bedroom lofts with private pools and massive kitchens and living areas. Every tower has its own unique features and amenities including state-of-the-art gym and pool! .

It is the ideal place to live as you can access the beach walk easily. Take a stroll down the walkway which is adjacent to the beach. The boardwalk is filled with different types of boutique pop-up stores and restaurants including Turkish ice cream stand, the famous smoky beach, Shake Shack, and P. F Chang and more. With so many things to do and to choose from, JBR is where beachfront living comes alive!
